north spider boss; its killtarget web is the only way into Spidercaves2, which leads (via rock wall #237) to the troll arena, the Tomb Guardian and the ww1 transition
Vakgar the Guardian; the 5/5 counter opens Orcforwall to the Orkat Forest transition; the reward chests (rewardchestorcs) stay closed
Guardian of the Tomb; ww1transmsg lowers the plate over the to_ww1 transition (and prints its message), telesprite shows the portal; treasureloot2 stays closed

west Stone Guardian; the 2-kill counter only spawns the TreasureSkeletons chest and removes the finite SkeletonArena spawner
east Stone Guardian; same counter as stoneguard_w, no walls depend on it
Arachnid Matriarch; her spawn (template target dr_spid_trap) is what seals the arena, so a held matriarch never closes the trap; hatchlings and spid_chest1 stay locked
Kharaztorant Childre (hp 1000, 200 XP); no killtarget or perishtarget, the cave stays two-way
Cave Ogre (swamp_ogre, hp 2000, 400 XP); its killtarget only removes the music_ogre battle-music area
